question: In January 2021, the Defence Research Development Organisation (DRDO) developed India's first indigenous machine pistol called ‘Asmi’ in collaboration with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Infantry School, Mhow.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has developed the country's first indigenous machine pistol ASMI in collaboration with Infantry School, Mhow.**
 
• The pistol is set to replace the **9mm pistols** in the defence forces.
 
• The machine pistol can fire at a range of **100 metres and is in the class of the Uzi series guns of Israel**.
 
• The prototype has fired over **300 rounds** in the last four months of its development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **About the weapon**-

 
 
• It has been developed by a young officer from Infantry School Lt Col Prasad Bansod.
 
• It was developed in a record time of four months.
 
• It has the capability of firing the in-service 9 mm ammunition.
 
• It has been named "Asmi" which means 'pride', 'Self-Respect', and "Hard Work'.
 
• The Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE) of DRDO, in Pune, has designed and developed the weapon.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is an agency under the Department of Defence Research and Development in the Ministry of Defence of the Government of India.
 
• **Founded**-1958.
 
• **Headquarters**-DRDO Bhavan, New Delhi.
 
• **Chairman**-Samir V Kamat
 
• **Minister of Defence**-Rajnath Singh (as of Jan 2021).
 
• **Constituency**-Lucknow.
